verdicts.reason: A stays faithful to the original, with a centered two-line headline, chevrons and nurse in the same order. Its main flaw is that the nurse's body is cut off flat about 50px above the bottom edge, leaving a purple strip under it instead of bleeding off the canvas as in the original. The headline is also a little tight to the top. B breaks the headline into four lines with orphan-like breaks ('10,000' / 'patients'), set left of centre with a dead area to its right. It blows the chevrons up into an oversized bottom-left graphic that competes with the headline and points at nothing, and shrinks the nurse into the corner with the same floating flat-cropped body, so the balance and hierarchy are off.
